中文摘要

我们报告一例未特征化的喉气管发育不全变异，伴有食管气道连续性，强调现有分类系统的局限性，并展示原发性环气管吻合术的可能性。随着对这些异常认识的增加，仔细的解剖描述和个体化手术重建对于推动该领域发展和改善这些具有挑战性患者的预后至关重要。

英文摘要

We present an uncharacterized laryngotracheal agenesis variant with esophageal airway continuity, highlight limitations of existing classification systems, and demonstrate the possibility of primary crico-tracheal anastomosis. As awareness of these anomalies increases, careful anatomic description and individualized surgical reconstruction will be essential to advance the field and improve outcomes for these challenging patients.
